description.p: A Rust port of Luminance: control the brightness of built-in and external displays (DDC/CI), with optional software dimming below the hardware minimum.

ul.li: Built-in panels through systemd-logind, no udev rules required
External monitors through DDC/CI, including contrast
Extra dimming below the minimum on GNOME, Cinnamon, KDE Plasma, Hyprland and other wlroots compositors
Command line and D-Bus interface for hotkeys

description.p: Windows support (installer and portable build) and a Debian package.
Rewrite in Rust with software dimming and Flatpak-friendly permissions.
